pressed-overlay-inverse.$description: Pressed interaction overlay for a surface whose fill is LIGHT, so the wash darkens: the next rung above hover-overlay-inverse (Black/3 -> Black/5 light, White/3 -> White/5 dark). The mirror of ki.state-layer.pressed, which is the next rung above hover-overlay and washes the other way. Two conventions exist because ki-button paints primary on a dark fill and secondary on a light one; a single pressed overlay would lighten one of them on press and read as less pressed, not more.

A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).

control.$description: The boundary of a control that can be EMPTY — field, checkbox, radio, switch. Such a control carries no label inside its own box, so the box IS what identifies it and must clear WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 against every surface it can sit on (s0-s2). Pinned to an accessibility floor, NOT to a position in the emphasis ramp: rebalancing outline.base/low/med/high must never silently erase a control's edge. MarsUI draws Outline/Black-8 here, but as a bevel over a filled cell on a fixed canvas — transcribed literally it measured 1.19:1 against a fill identical to the page (audit 2026-07-25). Declared deviation.

no-backdrop-filter.$description: An unadorned surface applies no backdrop filter.

MarsUI Component_effect/primary_hover: drops 0/20/20/-12 + 0/3/3/-1.5 + 0/1/1/-0.5 plus inner White/18 0/3/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.
MarsUI Component_effect/secondary_default: drop 0/2/1.5/-0.5 plus inner White/3 0/2/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.
MarsUI Component_effect/secondary_hover: drops as primary_hover plus inner White/8 0/2/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.

menu-backdrop-filter.$description: Optional complete backdrop filter for a raised action menu.

video-hover-opacity.$description: Opacity of the added play-container shadow on hover. onmars shows the full primary hover effect over the resting shadow.

small-dark-shadow.$description: MarsUI Small_dark_shadow: drop 0/2/3/-1.5 in Elevation/shadow_dark (Black/32 light, Black/48 dark). Lifts small light glyphs off saturated fills — the radio selected dot and the switch pointer carry it in the masters.

primary.$description: MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread focus ring of Outline/primary_base_em_alpha, read from the Figma master as #845abe33 = brand 500 at 20% (Kimen name: outline.primary-base-em-alpha / brand.500-alpha-2). The previous 40% (outline.primary-low-em-alpha / brand.500-alpha-4) came from specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5, which read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode and recorded it as the Light value; the ring shipped 2x too strong in light and 2.8x in dark across twelve components.

gray.$description: MarsUI Focus/gray: 3px spread focus ring of Outline/med_em (scheme-aware via the outline token).

danger.$description: MarsUI Focus/danger: persistent 3px spread ring of Outline/danger_base_em_alpha (danger-500 at 20% light / 40% dark) — the danger state signal on Input_field and Dropdown masters (measured rgb(252,220,219) over white). Pairs with a white fill and hairline border; Kimen keeps its opaque danger border on top as a declared a11y deviation.

action-joined-gap.$description: Space between actions that share an edge.

action-hairline.$description: Width of the frame and divider in an action surface.

count-size.$description: Minimum diameter of a notification marker that displays a count.

dot-size.$description: Diameter of a notification or presence dot.

ring-width.$description: Width of the separator between a notification marker and its trigger.

padding-inline.$description: Inline padding of a notification marker with a count.

radius.$description: Pill radius of a notification marker.

density.$description: Region density (spec 045). The three tokens are inherited from the document root, never redeclared on a theme root, and consumed directly by component CSS, so a density declaration on any element reaches every component inside it, in any theme. Nothing aliases them and no theme or mode reassigns them or what they reference (the build checks both).

control-offset.$description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

space-scale.$description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

target-min.$description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

inline.$description: Small radius for an outline around inline content.

control.$description: Deprecated alias kept for pre-Fase-1 consumers; use ki.radius.md.

activity-mark.$description: Round corners for rings and typing dots.

action-frame.$description: Outside corner of an action surface.

action-seam.$description: Square corner at an edge shared by two actions.

short-1.$description: Shortest step of the duration scale. M3 md.sys.motion.duration.short1 (50ms). onmars: the MarsUI single-speed language (120ms), short steps collapse onto ki.duration.fast.

medium-1.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).

medium-2.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium2 (300ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms).

medium-3.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium3 (350ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms).

medium-4.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium4 (400ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms).

long-1.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.long1 (450ms). onmars: MarsUI slow step (360ms, 3x the 120ms base).

long-2.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.long2 (500ms). onmars: MarsUI slow step (360ms).

long-3.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.long3 (550ms). onmars: MarsUI slow step (360ms).

long-4.$description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.long4 (600ms). onmars: MarsUI slow step (360ms).

instant.$description: Zero-duration step: transitions that must complete immediately (reduced-motion fallbacks, instant handoffs).

activity-rotation.$description: Period of an indeterminate activity rotation.

activity-rotation-reduced.$description: Period of an indeterminate activity rotation with reduced motion.

activity-pulse.$description: Period of an indeterminate typing pulse.

activity-stagger.$description: Stagger between neighboring marks of an activity pulse.

emphasized.$description: Expressive hero-transition curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.emphasized. onmars: the MarsUI standard curve (single-curve language).

emphasized-decelerate.$description: Expressive entrance curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.emphasized-decelerate. onmars: the MarsUI decelerate curve (ki.easing.out).

emphasized-accelerate.$description: Expressive exit curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.emphasized-accelerate. onmars: the MarsUI accelerate curve (ki.easing.in).

standard-decelerate.$description: Utility entrance curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.standard-decelerate. onmars: the MarsUI decelerate curve (ki.easing.out).

standard-accelerate.$description: Utility exit curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.standard-accelerate. onmars: the MarsUI accelerate curve (ki.easing.in).

spring.$description: Compatibility name for the theme’s expressive exit curve.
spring.$deprecated: The onmars curve now eases out without overshoot.

emphasized-out.$description: Expressive exit curve for selected controls. Onmars eases out without overshoot.
